snippet.title: Shady Job - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Shady Job is a co-op adventure game. The mafia wants to get rid of a body. You’re construction workers. Your job: carry a body bag to the top of a skyscraper. Bury it in concrete. Two problems. First: You have to build the way up. Second: The body’s not dead. It fights back. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4190710/Shady_job/

Developer: GAZE IN GAMES
X: https://x.com/GAZE_IN_GAMES
